task: Image-first native pixel cutscene asset candidates: relay power, guardian core ignition, workshop return. No AI video or game implementation.

assets.name: relay
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: individual production anchor for Clockwork A2 power-relay cutscene.
Input images: 1 is reference ONLY, especially top-right panel A2 for materials and narrative beat; ignore all other panels and all labels. 2 is the existing native-pixel factory for material language and clustered-pixel density, not a target to edit.
Primary request: a close side-on view of ONE heavy mechanical steel-and-brass electrical relay. One rectangular contact assembly on the LEFT CENTER with a small brass bridging arm and a clearly separated steel base; three cyan indicator apertures. A single rigid insulated conduit/cable leaves that relay and bends once toward the RIGHT edge; a thin segmented CYAN illuminated stripe along that cable makes the direction of power readable. Do not make an extra eye or robot. Background is restrained dark navy flat steel wall panels, rivets and only a few brass pipe couplings. It is a real industrial contact switch, not a glowing magic crystal. Its relay indicator and existing cable stripe are the only cyan accents for a later localized power-on sequence.
Composition: fixed side-on macro, no extreme perspective; relay sits at x about 0.35 of the frame, cable runs to the right; rigid arm and contact silhouettes very easy to identify. The circuit is energized in this source image, with a restrained bright cyan ramp, not a bloom cloud. No characters, no red.
Style/medium: actual crisp 2D PIXEL ART for a native 640x360 game cutscene, enlarged presentation of an intentional low-resolution pixel grid. Broad readable clustered pixels, stepped hard edges and limited roughly 64-color ramps. Match the existing game's dark steel, navy and brass materials. No smooth painted shading, no photographic texture, no 3D rendered lighting, no bloom, blur, depth of field, particles covering shapes, gradients, typography, HUD, borders, panel divisions, logo or watermark. Exactly ONE landscape 16:9 scene, not a contact sheet. Compose for deterministic native-pixel cleanup and small local animation; clear rigid separable mechanical shapes.

assets.name: workshop

Primary request: the same modest empty Elias mechanical workshop shown in B3, as one quiet 16:9 side-on room. Keep the room recognizably sheltered and simple, no grand architecture. The task lamp's warm amber light falls on the familiar empty place at the bench. A few clearly separated tiny AMBER dust-pixel flecks are visible in the lamp's local light; keep their amount sparse so they can become small native-pixel animation layers. A dim cyan indicator may remain on the back wall. Fixed front/side view with broad silhouettes and uncluttered workshop area. The SAME base image will be cropped for B4, so place the lamp, clock and bench together in the central approximately 60% of the frame.
